# Divine Leads

> Divine Leads is a done-for-you patient-acquisition system for aesthetic, cosmetic, and elective
> healthcare clinics in India. It closes the gap between a patient enquiry and a booked, showed-up
> consultation: instant response at any hour, relentless multi-week follow-up written in the clinic's
> voice, qualification, calendar booking, and auditable attribution. Divine Leads does not sell leads
> and does not provide medical advice — it installs the engine that converts the enquiries a clinic
> already gets.

## What it does
- Instant enquiry response (booking rates fall sharply after the first few minutes/hours).
- Follow-up that does not stop at message two, in the clinic's own tone, escalating to a human.
- Consultation booking straight into the clinic's calendar, with reminders to lift show-up rates.
- Marketing data only — patient enquiries stay in the clinic's own systems; no clinical records.

## Who it is for
Hair transplant, aesthetic dermatology, plastic/cosmetic surgery, cosmetic dentistry, bariatric, and
fertility/IVF clinics in India with 30+ enquiries a month and average treatment value ₹25,000+.
